// Generated by gtar1-export.cjs from demo-seed/gtar1DemoReset.ts.txt. GTAR1 demo build only (#417).
// The demo keeps data on this device. It starts fresh when the seed changes, after 15 minutes of
// inactivity, or when the visitor chooses "Reset demo". The reset runs before the app opens its
// library database, and keeps display settings (theme, font, stage layout).
const SEED_VERSION = '__SEED_VERSION__'
const IDLE_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000
const VERSION_KEY = 'gtar1_demo_seed_version'
const ACTIVE_KEY = 'gtar1_demo_last_active'
const PENDING_KEY = 'gtar1_demo_reset_pending'
const BANNER_HIDDEN_KEY = 'gtar1_demo_banner_hidden'
const DATABASES = ['gtar_library_db', 'gtar_recovery_archives_db']
const KEEP_SETTINGS = /^gtar_(theme|custom_theme|standalone_custom|factory_theme|font|is_two_column|edge_swipe|stage_)/

const isDemo = import.meta.env.VITE_GTAR1_DEMO === '1'

function readNumber(key: string): number {
  try { return Number(localStorage.getItem(key)) || 0 } catch { return 0 }
}

function shouldReset(): boolean {
  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem(PENDING_KEY) === '1') return true
    if (localStorage.getItem(VERSION_KEY) !== SEED_VERSION) return true
    const last = readNumber(ACTIVE_KEY)
    return last > 0 && Date.now() - last > IDLE_MS
  } catch { return false }
}

function deleteDatabase(name: string): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    try {
      const timer = setTimeout(resolve, 3000)
      const done = () => { clearTimeout(timer); resolve() }
      const request = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(name)
      request.onsuccess = done
      request.onerror = done
      request.onblocked = done
    } catch { resolve() }
  })
}

async function resetDemoData(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    const drop: string[] = []
    for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
      const key = localStorage.key(i)
      if (key && key.startsWith('gtar_') && !KEEP_SETTINGS.test(key)) drop.push(key)
    }
    drop.forEach(key => localStorage.removeItem(key))
  } catch { /* Storage unavailable: the demo still opens with whatever it has. */ }
  await Promise.all(DATABASES.map(deleteDatabase))
}

function markActive(): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(ACTIVE_KEY, String(Date.now())) } catch { /* ignore */ }
}

function requestReset(): void {
  try { localStorage.setItem(PENDING_KEY, '1') } catch { /* ignore */ }
  window.location.reload()
}

function startActivityTracking(): void {
  let lastWrite = 0
  const touch = () => {
    const now = Date.now()
    if (now - lastWrite < 10_000) return
    lastWrite = now
    markActive()
  }
  for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'keydown', 'touchstart', 'scroll'] as const) window.addEventListener(type, touch, { passive: true, capture: true })
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return
    // Back after a long absence: reload so the reset runs before the library opens.
    if (Date.now() - readNumber(ACTIVE_KEY) > IDLE_MS) requestReset()
    else touch()
  })
}

function showBanner(): void {
  try { if (sessionStorage.getItem(BANNER_HIDDEN_KEY) === '1') return } catch { /* ignore */ }
  const bar = document.createElement('div')
  bar.setAttribute('role', 'note')
  bar.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:8px;bottom:8px;z-index:60;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;max-width:calc(100vw - 16px);padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;font:12px system-ui,sans-serif;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25)'
  const text = document.createElement('span')
  text.textContent = 'Demo: resets after 15 min of inactivity.'
  const reset = document.createElement('button')
  reset.type = 'button'
  reset.textContent = 'Reset demo'
  reset.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Reset demo data to the original sample songs')
  reset.style.cssText = 'cursor:pointer;background:none;border:0;color:#7dd3fc;font:inherit;text-decoration:underline;padding:0'
  reset.addEventListener('click', requestReset)
  const close = document.createElement('button')
  close.type = 'button'
  close.textContent = '×'
  close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Hide demo notice')
  close.style.cssText = 'cursor:pointer;background:none;border:0;color:inherit;font:inherit;padding:0 2px'
  close.addEventListener('click', () => {
    try { sessionStorage.setItem(BANNER_HIDDEN_KEY, '1') } catch { /* ignore */ }
    bar.remove()
  })
  bar.append(text, reset, close)
  document.body.appendChild(bar)
}

async function start(): Promise<void> {
  if (shouldReset()) await resetDemoData()
  try { localStorage.setItem(VERSION_KEY, SEED_VERSION); localStorage.removeItem(PENDING_KEY) } catch { /* ignore */ }
  markActive()
  startActivityTracking()
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', showBanner, { once: true })
  else showBanner()
}

/** Resolves when the demo storage is ready; the app loads after it. */
export const gtar1DemoReady: Promise<void> = isDemo && typeof window !== 'undefined' ? start() : Promise.resolve()
